question: When was the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana launched?
solution:
The correct answer is **"August 2014".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PMJDY **was launched by Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi on **28th August 2014.**
 
• This scheme is launched to provide** banking services **to all the households in the country.
 
• This scheme provides financial services to citizens like the availability of basic savings bank accounts, credit, insurance, pension,
